hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) node_modules/.bin/oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; node_modules/.bin/oxlint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.json|*.jsonc|*.md|*.css|*.html|*.yml|*.yaml) node_modules/.bin/oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
